_note: Legacy (v1) problems relocated here in Phase 3A.1 from sliding-window-two-pointers/monotonic-deque-window, where they were mis-filed; their own tags already said monotonic-stack. They live in a sibling file because monotonic-stack.json is generated from an authoring spec and would overwrite hand-added problems. Migrate these into the authoring pipeline as part of the v1 to v2 work (defect D7).

problems.title: Sum of Subarray Minimums
problems.description: Sum over all subarrays of the minimum element, mod 10^9+7.
problems.approach_optimal: For each element, use monotonic stack to find left/right nearest smaller. Contribution = arr[i] * left_count * right_count. O(N).

problems.title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
problems.description: Largest rectangular area in histogram of heights.
problems.approach_brute: O(N^2) by expanding around each bar.
problems.approach_optimal: Monotonic increasing stack of indices. On pop, compute area with popped height as the limiting one. O(N).

problems.title: Maximum Subarray Min-Product
problems.description: Min-product of subarray = sum * min. Find max over all subarrays. Mod 10^9+7.
problems.approach_optimal: Monotonic stack to find for each element the maximal range it dominates as min; use prefix sums for O(1) sum lookup. O(N).
